summary: Kharsa Clinics has 38 years of history, 30,000 smiles and 24 before and after cases. Leftover text, broken profile links and misspellings weaken a clinic that has this much to show.

findings.problem: Stray text appears at the top and bottom of the page: Dear User, an in-app browser notice, and For better web experience please use portrait mode. The newsletter field shows youremail@gmail.com as visible text.
findings.cost: Leftover system messages make a long established clinic look unmaintained at the first glance.
findings.fix: A clean page with no system notices and a proper newsletter field.

findings.problem: The menu and URLs say Testinomials, and the pages are labelled Testinomials-7 to -23. Terms & Conditons is also misspelled.
findings.cost: A misspelled Testimonials page on a clinic selling trust undermines the proof it contains.
findings.fix: Correctly spelled, clean page names and URLs.

findings.problem: Several profile links point to the wrong people: Mona Taher links to another profile, and five staff profiles use the same chris-don slug. Doctors named in reviews, such as Dr Manal, are not in the roster.
findings.cost: A patient who clicks a doctor and lands on someone else, or finds no one, loses confidence in the whole clinic.
findings.fix: Correct profile pages for every doctor and a roster that matches your reviews.

findings.problem: Booking goes to a separate page with no inline form. The 24 before and after cases are bare links with no captions or outcomes, and several sections appear twice.
findings.cost: Every extra click costs bookings, and uncaptioned results do not prove what you did for each patient.
findings.fix: A booking form in the hero and captioned before and after cases beside it.

redesign: A proof first homepage that turns 38 years, 30,000 smiles and 24 cases into captioned, visible results.
A booking form in the hero plus WhatsApp, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
Correct doctor profiles and treatment pages in Arabic and English written to rank in search.
